## Runs 6 + 7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0: electron n = +3.2×10¹², hole n = −1.2×10¹²

**Raw:** both complete, no rails (sr1 ≤ 0.12 of 5 kΩ FS), no sustained gate leakage. Run 6 (electron): oscillations visible from ≲ 1 T; MR + SdH maxima to ~530 Ω at 8–9 T. Run 7 (hole): oscillations on a rising MR background to ~576 Ω at 10 T; onset 0.71 T.

**Electron side (run 6) — the decisive record.** FFT (1.5–10 T, deg-5 bg in B): tones at **7.05, 22.90, 29.94, 15.85 T** plus a weak high-F comb (37.0 ≈ 29.9+7.05, 44.0, 51.1, 59.9 ≈ 2×29.9). The exact algebra — 7.05 + 22.90 = 29.95 and 22.90 − 7.05 = 15.85, both within one FFT bin — reads as **two fundamentals + a breakdown sum tone at F_L + intermodulation**, the ABAB template with the symmetry-allowed inter-block breakdown the investigation says to expect. One global scale s = 29.94/33.09 = **0.905** (inside the 0.8–1.2 lever-arm prior; implied n = 2.9×10¹²) puts the model ABAB pair (fs_count_b0 at 2.9×10¹²: light ≈ 6.4, heavy ≈ 23.6 T; partition 0.21/0.79) against measured 7.05/22.90 (partition 0.235/0.765). ABCA (singleton at F_L, no partner) cannot produce this 4-tone set. **Open ambiguity, deliberately left to the fan:** {15.85, 22.90, 29.94} all sit exactly +1×δF (δF = 1.76 T full-record) above the 7.05-harmonic comb {14.1, 21.2, 28.2}, so a shifted-harmonic reading of a single 7 T pocket is not yet excluded by frequencies alone; the fan's n-dependence separates them (a harmonic tracks k·f_light(n) exactly; a real heavy pocket follows its own Onsager curve). B-window split on the 29.94 tone (breakdown vs pocket) is inconclusive in this window — deferred to fan + LK.

**Hole side (run 7) — consistent, not decisive.** The designed near-CNP exception regime (only reaches n = −1.27×10¹² at the TG limit). Tones: 5.28 T (≈ model ABAB light 5.3), 10.57 = 2×5.28 (harmonic), a tracked 6.6 T tone (≈ model heavy 7.1), 14.09 T unassigned; F_L = 12.4. Consistent-with ABAB; resolvability-limited as predicted.

**Take:** electron side is the fan side — strong SNR (peak tone SNR ~90), tones separated, onset for the heavy/sum tones 1.4–1.9 T (light-tone content censored at the 0.3 T record edge — a lower bound, and the sub-1 T leg of run 6 is 50 mT-coarse, aliased for the 7 T tone, so the true light onset is unpinned; noted, not blocking). Working hypothesis after Step 3: **ABAB (two FS + breakdown), pending the fan's F(n) trajectories and the harmonic screen**.

# Runs 6 + 7 — sdh-spot-check read: raw MR first, then FFT in 1/B vs the FS-count model
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, sdh_onset, sdh_fft, luttinger_frequency

I_BIAS = 10e-9
RFS = 50e-6 / I_BIAS                       # 5 kOhm full scale (sr1 gain 1)
# model tones: fs_count_b0 (ABAB SWMcC / ABCA 8-band), hera_scratch/model_Fn_electron.json + md_spot_h table
MODEL = {6: dict(n="+3.2e12 (electron)", FL=33.09, abab=(25.78, 7.31), note="ABCA singleton 33.1"),
         7: dict(n="-1.2e12 (hole)",     FL=12.41, abab=(7.1, 5.3),    note="ABCA singleton 12.4")}

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 7.5))
for row, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    r = open_run(f"data/{rid}")
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); idx = np.argsort(B); B = B[idx]
    Rxx = (r.col("sr1_X")[idx] / 1.0) / np.abs(r.col("sr0_X")[idx] / 1e6)   # measured-I normalized
    on = sdh_onset(Rxx, B, r_full_scale=RFS)
    print(f"— run {rid} ({MODEL[rid]['n']}), F_L = {MODEL[rid]['FL']} T —")
    print(on.summary())

    ax = axes[row, 0]                                          # raw first
    ax.plot(B, Rxx, lw=0.6); ax.axvline(on.onset_b, color="r", ls="--", lw=0.8)
    ax.set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("Rxx (Ω)")
    ax.set_title(f"run {rid} raw — {MODEL[rid]['n']}")

    cut = 1.5
    f, sp = sdh_fft(Rxx[:, None], B, b_range=(cut, B.max())); sp = sp[0]
    pk, pr = find_peaks(sp, prominence=(sp.max() - sp.min()) * 0.05)
    print(f"  FFT peaks ({cut}-{B.max():.0f} T):", ", ".join(
        f"{f[p]:.2f} T ({f[p]/MODEL[rid]['FL']:.2f} F_L)" for p in pk[np.argsort(-pr['prominences'])][:6]))
    ax = axes[row, 1]
    ax.plot(f, sp, "k", lw=0.9)
    ax.axvline(MODEL[rid]["FL"], color="g", lw=1.0, label="F_L / ABCA")
    ax.axvline(MODEL[rid]["abab"][0], color="g", ls="--", lw=0.8, label="ABAB heavy (model)")
    ax.axvline(MODEL[rid]["abab"][1], color="g", ls=":", lw=0.8, label="ABAB light (model)")
    ax.set_xlim(0, MODEL[rid]["FL"] * 2); ax.legend(fontsize=7)
    ax.set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("FFT amp"); ax.set_title(f"run {rid} FFT (1/B) vs model")

    m = B >= cut
    dR = Rxx[m] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[m], Rxx[m], 5), B[m])
    ax = axes[row, 2]
    ax.plot(1 / B[m], dR, lw=0.6)
    ax.set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax.set_ylabel("ΔRxx (Ω)"); ax.set_title(f"run {rid} ΔRxx vs 1/B")

fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nrun 6 tone algebra: 7.05 + 22.90 = 29.95 (sum/breakdown @ 0.905·F_L), 22.90 - 7.05 = 15.85 (intermod);")
print("global scale 0.905 -> ABAB pair partition measured 0.235/0.765 vs model 0.21/0.79 at n = 2.9e12")

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan-vti`), n = +1.0 → +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 1.2 → 10 T uniform-1/B

> **05:27** · LF e-side D=0: n +1.0->+3.2e12 61 pts; B 1.2->10 T uniform-1/B 124 rows (d(1/B) 5.96e-3, Nyq 84 T); sr1 50 uV, fast\_delay 1.8 s (6 tau); ends 10 T, gates parked · **ETA ~11:17** (≈5h50m)

**Why this fan (runs 6/7, ana):** the electron spot check resolved a two-fundamental set {7.05, 22.90 T} with a sum tone at 29.94 = 0.905·F_L and an intermodulation tone at 15.85 — the ABAB template with symmetry-allowed breakdown — but frequencies alone leave a shifted-harmonic reading of a single 7 T pocket unexcluded (all three upper tones sit +1·δF above the 7.05 comb). The fan's per-column F(n) decides: harmonics track k·f_light(n) exactly, a real heavy pocket follows its own Onsager curve, and the Luttinger sum f₁+f₂ = s·F_L(n) must hold across density (investigation Steps 4–5). Hole side stays un-fanned: it reaches only n = −1.27×10¹² (TG limit), inside the near-CNP exception regime where run 7 was already resolvability-limited.

**Design (floored per `landau-fan` step 1 + VTI cost regime):**
- **B rows:** `field_invB(1.2, 10.0, 124)` ascending — Δ(1/B) = 5.96×10⁻³ /T, FFT Nyquist 83.9 T > the observed 59.9 T (2× sum tone) with margin; 5.5 pts/period on the 30 T tone. **B_lo = 1.2 T, not the measured 0.3 T onset** — that onset is `censored@edge` on the *light* tone (and the sub-1 T leg of run 6 is 50 mT-coarse/aliased, so it's a bound, not a measurement); uniform-1/B rows below 1.2 T cost ~2 min each and reaching 0.5 T would add ~220 rows (~7 h). The 1.2–10 T record gives the light tone 5.2 periods and per-column δF = 1.36 T; heavy-vs-sum splits (7.0 T at n = 3.2, scaled) resolve at ≥ 2·δF for n ≳ 2.4×10¹² — below that the read is the two trajectories + the light tone, stated as a coverage limit of the claim, not fixable by rows.
- **n columns:** 61 pts, +1.0 → +3.2×10¹² at D = 0 (run-5 cal), Δn = 0.037×10¹² → 3.2 pts per ray spacing at the 1.2 T low edge (≥ 2 floor). n_max = 3.2 keeps V_tg at +0.984, 16 mV under the validator; the low edge 1.0 covers the heavy-branch bend toward 0.95·F_L (an ABAB-only signature ABCA's straight F = F_L line can't produce).
- **Dynamic range:** sensitivity stays 50 µV = 5 kΩ FS (spot-check-inherited). Worst corner is low-n × high-B: run 7 at |n| = 1.2 (closer to CNP than any fan column) peaked at 576 Ω at 10 T → ≥ 6× headroom; low-B signal ~70 Ω = 1.4 % FS matched the spots, whose FFTs were clean.
- **Settling:** `fast_delay = 1.8 s` = 6τ (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct — the per-column-FFT floor, `landau-fan` step 7); `slow_delay = 1`.

**Price (calibrated on run 5: 1.17 s/pt at fast_delay = 1.0 → per-point ≈ fast_delay + 0.17 s):** grid 124 × 61 × 1.97 s ≈ 4 h 08 m; field ramps 0 → 1.2 → 10 T ≈ 73 min + 124 × 3 s settles ≈ 6 m; flybacks ~4 m → ≈ 5 h 30 m, headline **≈ 5 h 50 m** (+5–10 % realistic). Ends at **10 T, gates parked at 0** — the follow-up (LK mass split or firming fan) rides the magnet down.

**Checkpoints:** first rows via `hera-watch` (leakage, dead/flat channel, field tracking, low-B signal level); interim per-column FFT on landed rows at ~2 h (B ≈ 2 T, light tone forming) and ~4 h (B ≈ 5–6 T, heavy/sum tones resolvable at high n) — continue/adjust/abandon each with the ~2 h remaining-cost of the balance.

# === Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan-vti`): n = +1.0 -> +3.2e12 at D = 0, B 1.2 -> 10 T uniform-1/B ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages
from hera.analysis import field_invB

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
ns = np.linspace(1.0, 3.2, 61)                  # 1e12 cm^-2, electron side
Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)                          # D = 0 line
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert (Vtgs >= TG_MIN).all() and (Vtgs <= TG_MAX).all(), (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max())
assert (Vbgs >= BG_MIN).all() and (Vbgs <= BG_MAX).all(), (Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
print(f"n-line: {len(ns)} pts, n = {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f} e12 at D = 0; "
      f"Vtg [{Vtgs.min():+.4f}, {Vtgs.max():+.4f}], Vbg [{Vbgs.min():+.4f}, {Vbgs.max():+.4f}] V")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff left field at 0), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- slow field axis: uniform in 1/B, ascending (magnet at 0; fan ends at 10 T for the ride-down follow-up)
B_vec = field_invB(1.2, 10.0, 124)              # d(1/B) = 5.96e-3 /T -> FFT Nyquist 83.9 T > 59.9 T (2x sum tone)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)                          # 5 kOhm FS (spot-check-inherited; worst corner ~576 Ohm, run 7)
_tau = sr1.time_constant()
assert abs(_tau - 0.3) < 0.01, _tau             # fast_delay = 6*tau below assumes tau = 0.3 s
print(f"B rows: {len(B_vec)}, {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T uniform-1/B; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {_tau} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan electron side: n = {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f} e12, D = 0 (run-5 cal), "
                  f"B = {B_vec[0]:.2f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.2f} T uniform-1/B {len(B_vec)} rows, sr1 50 uV, fast_delay 1.8")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'electron side, D = 0: n = {ns[0]:+.2f} to {ns[-1]:+.2f} e12 cm^-2 ({len(ns)} pts), '
              f'B = {B_vec[0]:.2f} to {B_vec[-1]:.2f} T uniform-1/B ({len(B_vec)} rows, d(1/B) = 5.96e-3); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'follows sdh-spot-check runs 6/7 (tones 7.05/22.90 + sum 29.94 at scale 0.905)')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg, Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f} V: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs], slow_delay=1, fast_delay=1.8)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)   # park gates; field endpoint (10 T) left for the ride-down follow-up
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, gates parked ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V")
